problem: Live delivery took 1,105 s against a 600 s target (693 s on v0.1.246-rc.2, 644 s on v0.1.245); #125 did not move it.
evidence: v0.1.247-rc.3 release.json delivery.live: server 1105 s, website 950 s, mobile-ota 662 s; checks 220 s
fix: Investigation: split the server step into image build, push and machine rollout from release records, then propose a measured fix. Confidence: high (timing), low (cause).

problem: Release cannot read live Android runtime data from Google Play; OTA uses previously recorded Android targets.
evidence: release-corner #jellybean-25896; GitHub denied secret metadata; vault has reporting credentials only
fix: OPEN QUESTION: a repository admin replaces GOOGLE_PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON in Actions secrets. Confidence: medium.

problem: iPhone app hits an unhandled keychain read error (User interaction is not allowed) when it starts while the phone is locked.
evidence: https://beeline-bt.sentry.io/issues/7867015259/ (BEELINE-MOBILE-19), 1 event, route index, unhandled rejection; OTA bundle has no source maps
fix: Catch the locked-keychain error in monolith-session reads and retry on app active; store session tokens with AFTER_FIRST_UNLOCK on iOS; upload OTA source maps. Confidence: medium.

problem: A Fly machine with no config stops the whole free-agent catch-up pass.
evidence: Server log TypeError reading 'metadata' at 18:29Z 24 Nov; apps/server/src/free-agents.ts:694 unchanged on live
fix: Use machine.config?.metadata in both reads in reconcileAll and add a test. Confidence: high.
peopleReason: no failed free-agent turn tied to the event

problem: A GitHub 503 during the check-summary refresh fails the webhook; PR check state lags until the next event.
evidence: Sentry SERVER-56 (3 at 05:16Z) and SERVER-5W (1 at 19:20Z)
fix: Retry the GitHub check read with a short backoff before failing the webhook. Confidence: medium.

problem: Since #147/#150 agents cannot post into another chat or thread, and some reply/review/brief ids are refused; loop reports get stranded.
evidence: 11 feedback reports 05:12Z-13:40Z (fb_fc7a56f0, fb_3ef21620, fb_8e2ac415, fb_3075937f, fb_0d8c8ce4, fb_6f946a31, fb_16a81d93, fb_05ecaad1, fb_90472e50, fb_70f122c7, fb_f9e3b19b)
fix: message normal accepts any chat or thread the agent belongs to and posts without waking; reply and review reply accept the turn-context id; retired ops return a refusal naming message. Confidence: high.

problem: Antigravity agents on stable helpers (v0.1.245) cannot start: the executor rejects the old search-tool regex. Fix #141 is only on next.
evidence: fb_733210cc, fb_f8ce2f61; chloropine report in #beeline; Neon worked after a next-channel update
fix: OPEN QUESTION: promote v0.1.247 to stable (owner command in release-corner). Confidence: high.

problem: A message that the thread list shows returns 403, or a sentence fragment, when read by id.
fix: Apply the message-list visibility rule in read(facet:message), store and return the full body, test both cases. Confidence: medium.

problem: BBC's turns are cancelled because the login proxy has no login serving gpt-6.1-sol.
evidence: 2 cancelled turns 23:06Z and 23:07Z 24 Nov; sign-in card posted 02:34Z; 3 pieces of work queued
fix: BBC's owner signs in from the card; no code change. Confidence: medium.

problem: Squire browser drives click stale controls or fail to start and stop early.
evidence: fb_d36ee604, fb_01aa6ab9, fb_fade858c; Ruby X ads drive 13:30Z
fix: External: send the traces to Trusty Squire. No repo change. Confidence: medium.

problem: Skill reads fail when an agent resolves them against its working directory instead of agent-home.
fix: Investigation: check whether the skill listing gives a relative path, then fix or drop. Confidence: low.

problem: Cold page loads breach 450 ms; cold root p95 639 ms, first socket operation at about 500 ms.
fix: Investigation: split entry evaluation from first React mount and measure one module deferral. Confidence: high (timing), medium (cause).

problem: Opening a direct chat breaches 150 ms (p95 162/167 ms); React DOM takes 74-78 ms.
fix: Investigation: profile the navigation render against the socket receive. Confidence: medium.

problem: Creating a thread breaches 150 ms (p95 159/160 ms); SQL is 49-72 ms of 52-76 ms server time.
fix: Investigation: correlate transaction reply and React commit. Confidence: medium.

problem: Slow DB reads held an 86% drop (335 vs 2,393 per day at equal webhook load); 317 of 335 fell in the 3 rollout hours.
fix: Investigation: check whether new machines take traffic before their DB pool is warm. Confidence: high (counts).

problem: Overnight latency reruns run on a busy host (mean load 13-26); 4 taps had one usable pass; the continuation lost its capture.
fix: Investigation: quiet-window launch with a load check, keep the checkout until the continuation ends. Confidence: high.
